columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This column holds the primary key for this table

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: The category id. This is a foreign key from the category tables.

columns.name: CATEGORY_KEY
columns.description: This column holds the category_key from the category table

columns.name: TOPIC_KEY
columns.description: This column holds the topic key for this table

columns.name: AVERAGE_SCORE
columns.description: This column stores average calculated score for the skill specified

columns.name: URL_LINK
columns.description: This column stores the url lik to the website that best teaches the skill set specified

columns.name: IS_SEEDED_DATA
columns.description: A flag indicating seeded data. Use Y for seeded data or N for customer data

columns.name: ACCURACY_VALUE
columns.description: This is the ACCURACY score for this topic.

columns.name: IMPORTANCE_VALUE
columns.description: This is the IMPORTANCE score for this topic.

columns.name: PRECISION_VALUE
columns.description: This is the PRECISION score for this topic.

columns.name: RELEVANCE_VALUE
columns.description: This is the RELEVANCE score for this topic.

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.description: A flag indicating active topics to be used. Use Y for true (active) or N for false (not active)

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
